title: Supreme Court: Henry Schein, Inc. v. Archer & White Sales, Inc.
summary: Certiorari dismissed as improvidently granted. (No. 19-963, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 592 U.S. 168).

title: Supreme Court: Chicago v. Fulton
summary: The mere retention of estate property after the filing of a bankruptcy petition does not violate 11 U. S. C. §362(a)(3), which operates as a “stay” of “any act” to “exercise control” over the property of the estate. (No. 19-357, opinion by Justice Alito; 592 U.S. 154).
